title: dots-superkit/memory-v1
description: The whole content of memory/<DOT>/<agentId>.json on Osaka: one agent's current session memory, rewritten whole by that agent only, at the same moments it appends a live record. Shape only. It summarizes the agent's own state; it is not evidence that a gate passed, not a submission and not a closure. Who writes it, when and how readers use it are in workflows/session-memory.md. Exactly these fields, all required, no extras.

t.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of this rewrite; the same t as the live record written with it.

dot.description: REM17 or REV18: the live/<DOT> folder the agent writes to.

agent.description: The same id as the agent's live records, roster slot and mail folder.

task.description: The approved task, the same value as the live record written with this memory.

state.description: The state of the live record written with this memory.

host.description: The host actually used, as in the live record.

goal.description: What the assignment is for, in the agent's words, within the coordinator's brief.

doing.description: What the agent is doing right now.

decisions.description: Choices the agent made on this task, oldest first, newest 20 kept. A choice that belongs to the owner or the coordinator is not recorded here as decided.

blockers.description: Open blockers, each naming the missing fact or capability. Empty when none. Non-empty whenever state is blocked.
